title: UAV Fault Diagnosis Using Signal Processing and Machine Learning
author: Al-Haddad, Jaber, et al.

steps.title: Select UAV Model
steps.instruction: Choose the DJI Mini Combo 2 UAV because of its stability and ease of modification.

steps.title: Choose Data Type and Sensor
steps.instruction: Identify vibration data as the required input for fault diagnosis and select a 3‑axis ADXL335 accelerometer to capture the vibrations accurately.

substeps.instruction: Identify vibration data as the target data type.

steps.title: Mount Accelerometer on Drone
steps.instruction: Secure the ADXL335 accelerometer to the drone frame using adhesive or mounting brackets and align it properly; proper alignment is critical for accurate vibration data.

substeps.instruction: Secure the sensor to the frame with adhesive or brackets.
Align the sensor to capture accurate vibration signals.

steps.title: Connect Sensor to DAQ
steps.instruction: Wire the accelerometer to the DAQ‑6009 using appropriate cables and verify that all connections are tight with no loose wiring.

substeps.instruction: Connect the sensor to the DAQ‑6009 via suitable cables.
Check that all connections are secure and free of loose wires.

steps.title: Calibrate Accelerometer
steps.instruction: Use LabVIEW software with the DAQ‑6009 to calibrate the ADXL335, then perform a test run and review the recorded data to confirm calibration accuracy.

substeps.instruction: Verify calibration by conducting a test run and reviewing the data.

steps.title: Configure Data Acquisition
steps.instruction: Set the DAQ‑6009 to record vibration data in the time domain, configure a high‑resolution sampling rate, set the recording duration to cover the entire hover mode, and connect the DAQ to a laptop or PC for data storage.

substeps.instruction: Set recording mode to time‑domain vibration data.
Ensure recording duration covers the full hover operation.
Connect the DAQ to a computer for data storage.

steps.title: Acquire Vibration Data
steps.instruction: Fly the UAV in hover mode while the DAQ records the vibration signals according to the configured settings, storing the data on the connected computer.

steps.title: Extract Signal Features
steps.instruction: Compute statistical time‑domain features (mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis), frequency‑domain features via FFT (spectral centroid, bandwidth, power spectral density), and time‑frequency features using wavelet transform or short‑time Fourier transform (wavelet coefficients, spectrogram statistics).

substeps.instruction: Extract time‑domain statistics: mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis.
Perform FFT to obtain spectral centroid, bandwidth, and power spectral density.
Apply wavelet transform or STFT to obtain wavelet coefficients and spectrogram statistics.

steps.title: Normalize and Process Data
steps.instruction: Normalize the extracted feature set to reduce the impact of outliers and ensure consistency before model training.

steps.title: Select Relevant Features
steps.instruction: Apply ReliefF or Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to the normalized data to select the most informative features and reduce dimensionality.

steps.title: Train and Test ML Models
steps.instruction: Split the dataset into training and testing subsets, train each machine‑learning model (SGD, DNN, SVM, kNN) on the training set, validate on the testing set, and calculate accuracy, precision, recall, and F1‑score for each model.

substeps.instruction: Divide data into training and testing sets.
Train SGD, DNN, SVM, and kNN models on the training set.
Validate models on the testing set and compute accuracy, precision, recall, and F1‑score.

steps.title: Compare Model Performance
steps.instruction: Analyze and compare the accuracy, precision, recall, and F1‑score of all trained models to determine the best‑performing algorithm.

steps.title: Assess Feature Effectiveness
steps.instruction: Compare classification results obtained with time‑domain, frequency‑domain, and time‑frequency feature sets to identify which set provides the highest classification accuracy and reliability.

steps.title: Summarize Findings
steps.instruction: Summarize the comparative analysis, highlighting the top‑performing model and the most effective feature set, and discuss the implications for UAV fault diagnosis and potential future research directions.
